meta.title: Synthetic two-jet energy-flow demo
meta.note: SYNTHETIC: hand-built, balanced two-jet illustration; not DELPHI detector data or a physics simulation. Six charged tracks, four neutral EM showers; no VD hits, displaced vertices, or RICH measurements. Jet weights include the particles and showers; do not sum the displayed weights.
